0022600173.text: The Pistons (6-1, 1st in the Central and 2nd in the East) host the 76ers (7-1, 1st in the Atlantic and 1st in the East) riding a three-game winning streak, with Detroit at 6-1 over its last ten. Detroit leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 106-93 win in Philadelphia on October 25, and the Pistons also won the 2025-26 series 4-0. Detroit is missing Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture).
